The voice guide is not available with a local voice in this language. You can continue using the app.
Choose your document type and enter its number and your password to sign in as a patient.
If you need a different institution or site, use Change IPS.
Select the institution and location to continue as a patient.
Check your selection and press Continue.
Complete your details and review the consent displayed on the screen before accepting.
If a validation message appears, check the indicated field before submitting the form again.
From the home screen, you can review your details and create a pre-registration when that action is available.
Open My requests to check their current statuses. Use Refresh to check again.
Review your details and edit only the enabled fields.
When finished, save your changes or return to the home screen. This guide will not read your details.
Select the location and enter your chief complaint in the form.
Review the fields before sending the pre-registration. You can then check its status from the home screen or My requests.
This screen lets you check the current status of your requests and the times they were sent.
Press Refresh to check again. The guide will not read the contents of the list.
This diagnostic screen lets you check the connection status with the service.
You can return to the access screen when you finish checking.
Wait while your session is verified before opening your workspace.
If verification fails, use Try again or Sign out.
Choose your language, theme, color mode, text size or accessible font.
You can change these preferences whenever you need. Reading changes do not modify the form data.
